data.text: Fresh Textures v2.0.1.1 (26.3 overlay) overrides only core/clouds.vsh (outputs loc 0-1). The Atmospherics 2.6.8 mod overrides the clouds.vsh+fsh pair, and its fsh reads loc 0-12. Resource packs outrank mod assets, so the pair is mismatched: the 8 cloud pipelines fail, the reload fails, and MC clears all selected packs. Fix: removed 26.3/.../clouds.vsh from the Fresh zip (original in pack-backups/Fresh Textures v2.0.1.1.orig.zip). Pack list was recovered from the 07:52:03 'Reloading ResourceManager' log line. A background watcher rewrites options.txt (resourcePacks + 9 incompatibleResourcePacks) when game pid 52715 exits; the old file is kept as options.txt.pre-restore.
